_about: Public-domain J. W. McGarvey (1829-1911), President of the College of the Bible, Lexington, Kentucky, and a leader of the Restoration Movement, for the Word Hoard: A Commentary on Acts of Apostles (1863), New Commentary on Acts of Apostles (2 vols., 1892), Lands of the Bible (1880; a printing of 1882), Evidences of Christianity (1886), Sermons Delivered in Louisville (1894), Jesus and Jonah (1896), A Guide to Bible Study (1897), The Authorship of the Book of Deuteronomy (1902), Short Essays in Biblical Criticism (1910), and, with Philip Y. Pendleton, The Fourfold Gospel (1914) and Thessalonians, Corinthians, Galatians, and Romans (1916). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 68 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
